summary.en: The 44-digit access key of NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, MDF-e and the other DF-e models.
summary.pt-BR: A chave de acesso de 44 dígitos da NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, MDF-e e demais documentos fiscais eletrônicos.

format.summary: Formats a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) into groups of 4 digits separated by spaces, the form every auxiliary document prints it in: the DANFE of the NF-e and the NFC-e, the DACTE of the CT-e, the CT-e OS and the GTV-e, the DAMDFE of the MDF-e, the DABPE of the BP-e, the DANF3E of the NF3e and the DANFE-COM of the NFCom.
description: Formats a DF-e access key into groups of 4 digits separated by spaces, as the DANFE and the other auxiliary documents print it. Does not validate (use `nfeKey.isValid`).
- A masked or partial key is grouped as far as its digits go; `options.pad` left-pads with zeros to 44 digits first.

getInfo.summary: Parses a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) into its fields.
description: Parses a DF-e access key into its fields; accepts the same input as `nfeKey.isValid` and returns null when the key is not valid.
- Fields: state (from the cUF), year, month, issuer tax id, model, series, number, emission type, numeric code and check digit.
- For NFCom and NF3e (models 62 and 66) the numeric code is 7 digits and the result also carries the authorization site.

isValid.summary: Validates a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso).
description: Validates a 44-digit DF-e access key: NF-e (55), NFC-e (65), CT-e (57), MDF-e (58), CT-e OS (67), GTV-e (64), BP-e (63), NF3e (66) and NFCom (62); the CF-e-SAT (59) is out.
- The cUF must be a state, the model one of the above and the emission type (`tpEmis`) one the MOC of that model assigns.
- For NF-e and NFC-e the numeric code (`cNF`) must pass rule B03-10 of the MOC (no repeated or sequential values, not the document number).
- A document number of all zeros is rejected; the check digit is a modulus 11 over the first 43 digits.
- The digits may be grouped in 4 by whitespace, `.`, `-` or `/`; the XML `Id` prefixes (`NFe`, `CTe`, `MDFe`, `BPe`, `NF3e`, `NFCom`) are stripped first.

parse.summary: Removes the formatting of a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) and returns only digits.
description: Removes the formatting of a DF-e access key and keeps only digits, capped to 44 digits.
- The XML `Id` prefixes (`NFe`, `CTe`, `MDFe`, `BPe`, `NF3e`, `NFCom`) are stripped first.
